children.text: Is this role open to new grads?

Acme Cloud | Backend Engineer | Remote (US) | Full-time

We build deployment and monitoring infrastructure for engineering teams. The Core API team is hiring a Backend Engineer to design and run our REST services.

Stack: Python, PostgreSQL, Redis, Docker, Kubernetes on AWS, Terraform. About 2 years of experience (or strong internships) is plenty; we mentor.

Details and how to apply: https://acmecloud.example/careers/backend-engineer
